query:
UPDATE cve_scans
        SET status = 'failed',
            completed_at = NOW(),
            attempts = attempts + 1,
            scan_metadata = COALESCE(scan_metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || 
                           jsonb_build_object('stale_recovered_at', NOW()::text,
                                              'stale_recovery_reason', 'server-crash-recovery')
        WHERE status = 'in_progress'
          AND created_at < NOW() - $1 * INTERVAL '1 second'
